key_patterns: SecuritySeverity.normalize(String)/rank(String)/worstOf(Collection<String>) is the single severity vocabulary (null-safe, unknown->MEDIUM). ResourceSecurityAggregationService wraps each product read in its own try/catch that appends a ProductError and never fails other groups; it sorts each group most-severe-first via the private sortBySeverity helper; empty groups are dropped by groups.removeIf in aggregate(). Deep links use new SecurityDeepLink(path, Map.of()) with an empty query for XamSecure tabs. The security snapshot key form is the 12-digit AWS id: '"security-" + account.getAwsAccountId()' (reader) == '"security-" + accountId' (SecurityController, accountId resolved via findByAwsAccountId) == ProactiveCacheRefreshService.getAccountId(account) which returns getAwsAccountId() for AWS. DashboardDataService.saveSecuritySnapshot(key, data) upserts cached_data; getSecuritySnapshot(key, typeRef, maxAgeHours) reads with an age gate.
